limitations: I2000 is the older integrated I recipe, not new S5. It changes batch/G/LR/retention together; no attribution to a single trick.
Training budgets differ: I2000 has32000 freshscenes/512000 PGqueries, Control10k20000/160000; retention verification/history adds more cost. This is full-score comparison, not matched compute.
No new bootstrap or significance claim: exact fullpopulation differences at one training/evaluation seed only.
Baseline compact receipts were reused with wholepopulation metadata+sealedcache checks; I2000/I250 each rawscene was read and validated once.
NAVTEST IDs and labels remain solely in analysis artifacts, never training bank/priority/teacher.
conclusions_zh: 旧综合I2k完整12146/44log/invalid0：PDMS=91.02554897，相IL70+2.232639、相I250+0.688189，相最高Control10k-0.428049；不是新纪录，也不是新S5。
相Control10k：全局正增益+0.575696、负损失-1.003744，净值-0.428049；安全/EP及固定高分队列分别列示，不能仅凭zero数量判断总收益。
固定IL70高分8724场景：I2k相IL全局净贡献-0.993937，Control10k为-0.557724；I2k相Control额外-0.436213，其余场景合计+0.008164。该固定队列下降几乎解释全部总分差距，不把按Control选高本身当因果遗忘。
相Control10k，5419场景NC/DAC/TTC完全相同但EP更低，贡献−0.478651 PDMS；全体EP均值低1.036478pp、DAC低0.131731pp、TTC高0.197596pp。总分差的score公式代数分解EP项−0.416762，不能因此断言参数梯度或物理冲突因果。
I2k的场景曝光/候选查询高于Control10k，且多个机制一起变化；差值是既有策略完整部署成绩比较，不是单一方法因果或等算力结论。
